description: deixis N[T] construction refusals — child keys are unique exact byte strings (ADR 0009 §3), so a spelling that lists one key twice under a node must not construct one, however the duplicate is placed and whatever the two subtrees are. Same case shape as vectors/invalid.json (the old model's refusals): the error class and the offending key. Hand-authored from docs/design/0009-optional-node-values.md alone, per vectors/NODE-PLAN.md; not generated by an implementation, and replayed against the four cores by tools/conformance/harness.mjs. Suggested as a coverage gap by the spec-alignment lane in its spelling review, 2026-09-23; the judgments are derived here from §3. Three names carry a node- prefix because invalid.json already holds the bare names for the old model's cases, and a case name is unique across every vector file (tools/conformance/README.md); the collision was found by the cores lane the first time the harness indexed this file. Under ADR 0010 this file reads as the explicit optional instantiation Node[Option[fixture]], with the tag-respecting option slot of vectors/MNODE-PLAN.md; every case here holds there under the mandatory core's generic laws (checked case by case on 2026-09-23; see NODE-PLAN.md).

cases.name: node-duplicate-key-adjacent
cases.note: The plain case: the same key twice, back to back. §3: child keys are unique.

cases.name: node-duplicate-key-nonadjacent
cases.note: A distinct key between the two occurrences. A check that compares only neighbours misses it.

cases.name: node-duplicate-empty-key
cases.note: X5. The empty key is a key and occupies its slot exactly once.

cases.name: duplicate-with-equal-children-is-not-merged
cases.note: The two subtrees are ≡ (same class). A construction that deduplicates equal entries instead of refusing fails here: a finite map has no second entry to merge.

cases.name: duplicate-under-a-valued-parent
cases.note: N-specific. The duplicate sits below a VALUED node. The old model had no valued node with children; an implementation that runs duplicate detection only on unvalued (struct-like) nodes misses it.

cases.name: duplicate-non-utf8-key
cases.note: X5/C4. Duplicate detection compares exact bytes, including keys that do not decode as UTF-8.
